description: Check a price printed on the agents4663 marketplace index against the service's own live x402 demand on Robinhood Chain (4663). Give either the service URL, or agentId + service. Optionally give printedUsd to grade a caller-supplied printed price. Returns the desk's receipt: verdict PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE with legs and evidence, recomputed live from the index and the live 402.

agentId.description: ERC-8004 agent id on the agents4663 marketplace (use with service).

printedUsd.description: Optional caller-supplied printed price in USD to grade instead of the index price.

service.description: Service name as listed on the index (use with agentId).

url.description: The service endpoint URL as listed on the agents4663 index.

name: flow_price_check
